prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6

               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (

        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT to_char(date_trunc($1, s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $3::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $4)::date BETWEEN $5::date AND $6::date
      
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
prisma:query 
        SELECT b.id, b.name,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        JOIN branches b ON b.id = s.branch_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
        GROUP BY b.id, b.name
        ORDER BY net DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor), 0) AS gross,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS refunds,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method,
               COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount_minor), 0) AS total,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date

prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6

prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor), 0) AS gross,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS refunds,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
prisma:query 
        SELECT to_char(date_trunc($1, s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $3::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $4)::date BETWEEN $5::date AND $6::date
      
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
prisma:query 
        SELECT b.id, b.name,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        JOIN branches b ON b.id = s.branch_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
        GROUP BY b.id, b.name
        ORDER BY net DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method,
               COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount_minor), 0) AS total,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
       AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC

        FROM sale_items si

        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit

prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query

        FROM inventory_balances b

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        JOIN branches b ON b.id = s.branch_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
        GROUP BY b.id, b.name
        ORDER BY net DESC

        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
       AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::int AS h,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
prisma:query SELECT COUNT(*) AS "_count$_all" FROM (SELECT "public"."stock_transfers"."id" FROM "public"."stock_transfers" WHERE ("public"."stock_transfers"."business_id" = $1 AND "public"."stock_transfers"."status" = CAST($2::text AS "public"."TransferStatus")) OFFSET $3) AS "sub"
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6

prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method, SUM(pay.amount_minor) AS total, COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

               COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount_minor), 0) AS total,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay

        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

        FROM payments pay JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)

prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::int AS h,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit

        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor), 0) AS gross,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS refunds,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
prisma:query 
        SELECT b.id, b.name,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        JOIN branches b ON b.id = s.branch_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
        GROUP BY b.id, b.name
        ORDER BY net DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT to_char(date_trunc($1, s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $3::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $4)::date BETWEEN $5::date AND $6::date
      
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method,
               COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount_minor), 0) AS total,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
       AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6
prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

prisma:query 
        SELECT b.id, b.name,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        JOIN branches b ON b.id = s.branch_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
        GROUP BY b.id, b.name
        ORDER BY net DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor), 0) AS gross,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS refunds,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method,
               COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount_minor), 0) AS total,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
       AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6
prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,

prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor), 0) AS gross,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS refunds,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
prisma:query 
        SELECT b.id, b.name,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        JOIN branches b ON b.id = s.branch_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
        GROUP BY b.id, b.name
        ORDER BY net DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method,
               COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount_minor), 0) AS total,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
       AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC
prisma:query

               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $3::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $4)::date BETWEEN $5::date AND $6::date

        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid

               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $3::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $4)::date BETWEEN $5::date AND $6::date

prisma:query 
        SELECT b.id, b.name,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        JOIN branches b ON b.id = s.branch_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
        GROUP BY b.id, b.name
        ORDER BY net DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method,
               COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount_minor), 0) AS total,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
       AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active

        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id

        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT to_char(date_trunc($1, s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $3::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $4)::date BETWEEN $5::date AND $6::date
      
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
prisma:query 
        SELECT b.id, b.name,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        JOIN branches b ON b.id = s.branch_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
        GROUP BY b.id, b.name
        ORDER BY net DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor), 0) AS gross,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS refunds,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method,
               COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount_minor), 0) AS total,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
       AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level

        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit

        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name
prisma:query 
        SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::int AS h,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method, SUM(pay.amount_minor) AS total, COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6
prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method, SUM(pay.amount_minor) AS total, COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6

prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6
prisma:query 
        SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::int AS h,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(si.quantity) AS qty, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue,
               SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 6

prisma:query 
        SELECT pr.name, SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) AS on_hand, pr.reorder_level AS reorder
        FROM inventory_balances b
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = b.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        WHERE b.business_id = $1::uuid AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND pr.is_active
          
        GROUP BY pr.id, pr.name, pr.reorder_level
        HAVING SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) <= pr.reorder_level
        ORDER BY SUM(b.quantity_on_hand) / NULLIF(pr.reorder_level, 0) ASC, pr.name
prisma:query 
        SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorised') AS name, SUM(si.line_total_minor) AS revenue
        FROM sale_items si
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = si.sale_id
        JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = si.product_variant_id
        JOIN products pr ON pr.id = v.product_id
        LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = pr.category_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date > ($3::date - $4::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS d,
               SUM(s.total_minor) AS revenue,
               COUNT(*) AS txns,
               COALESCE(SUM(p.profit), 0) AS profit
        FROM sales s
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT SUM(si.line_total_minor - (si.quantity * COALESCE(si.unit_cost_minor, 0))::bigint) AS profit
          FROM sale_items si WHERE si.sale_id = s.id
        ) p ON true
        WHERE s.business_id = $2::uuid AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')  AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $3)::date > ($4::date - $5::int)
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor), 0) AS gross,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS refunds,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
prisma:query 
        SELECT b.id, b.name,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        JOIN branches b ON b.id = s.branch_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
      
        GROUP BY b.id, b.name
        ORDER BY net DESC
prisma:query 
        SELECT to_char(date_trunc($1, s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d,
               COALESCE(SUM(s.total_minor - s.refunded_total_minor), 0) AS net,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.business_id = $3::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $4)::date BETWEEN $5::date AND $6::date
      
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
prisma:query 
        SELECT pay.method::text AS method,
               COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount_minor), 0) AS total,
               COUNT(*) AS txns
        FROM payments pay
        JOIN sales s ON s.id = pay.sale_id
        WHERE s.business_id = $1::uuid
      AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')
      AND (s.completed_at AT TIME ZONE $2)::date BETWEEN $3::date AND $4::date
       AND pay.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
        GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC
